name: Airborne
text: Rulebook: A card bearing this sigil will strike an opponent directly, even if there is a creature opposing it.

name: Amorphous
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is drawn, this sigil is replaced with another sigil at random.

name: Annoying
text: Rulebook: The creature opposing a card bearing this sigil gains 1 Power.

name: Ant Spawner
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, an Ant is created in your hand.

name: Armored
text: Rulebook: The first time a card bearing this sigil would take damage, prevent that damage.

name: Attack Conduit
text: Rulebook: Other creatures within a circuit completed by a card bearing this sigil gain 1 Power.

name: Battery Bearer
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, it provides an Energy Cell to its owner.

name: Bees Within
text: Rulebook: Once a card bearing this sigil is struck, a Bee is created in your hand. A Bee is defined as: 1 Power, 1 Health, Airborne.

name: Bellist
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, a Chime is created on each empty adjacent space. A Chime is defined as: 0 Power, 1 Health.

name: Bifurcated Strike
text: Rulebook: A card bearing this sigil will strike each opposing space to the left and right of the space across from it.

name: Blood Lust
text: When a card with this kills an opposing card, the card bearing this sigil will gain 1 Power. This power is removed after a battle ends, except specifically on the Hodag. This sigil is usually more useful on cards with higher Health, as it will have a better chance of having higher Power before dying.

name: Bomb Latch
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil perishes, its owner chooses a creature to gain the Detonator sigil.

name: Bomb Spewer
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, fill all empty spaces with Explode Bots.

name: Bone Dice
text: Bone Dice is an unused sigil that, when activated for 1 Bone sets the Power value of the card bearing it to a random whole number from 1 to 6.

name: Bone Digger
text: Rulebook: At the end of the owner's turn, a card bearing this sigil will generate 1 bone.

name: Bone King
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil dies, 4 Bones are awarded instead of 1.

name: Bonehorn
text: Rulebook: Activate: Pay 1 Energy to gain 3 Bones.

name: Brittle
text: Rulebook: After attacking, a card bearing this sigil perishes.

name: Brittle Latch
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil perishes, its owner chooses a creature to gain the Brittle sigil.

name: Brood Parasite
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this Sigil is played, an Egg is created on the opposing space.|speaker=Rule Book}}

name: Buff When Powered
text: Rulebook: If a card bearing this sigil is within a circuit, it gains 2 Power.

name: Burrower
text: Rulebook: When an empty space would be struck, a card bearing this sigil will move to that space to receive the strike instead.

name: Clinger
text: Rulebook: When one of your creatures is placed in a space, a card bearing this sigil will move towards them as far as possible.

name: Corpse Eater
text: Corpse Eater is a Sigil which causes a card to be automatically played in the place of the first of the player's cards to perish by combat. The effect requires the card bearing this sigil to be in the player's hand.

name: Dam Builder
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, a Dam is created on each empty adjacent space. A Dam is defined as: 0 Power, 2 Health.

name: Dead Byte
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil perishes, select a file. Place damage on the scales according to the file's size.

name: Detonator
text: Detonator is a Sigil that appears in Act II and Act III. When a Card bearing this Sigil dies, all adjacent cards (those to the left, right and front of the card) are dealt 10 damage. This effect doesn't apply for sacrificing a card bearing this Sigil, but destroying it with the hammer does activate the Sigil.

name: Disentomb
text: Rulebook: Activate: Pay 1 Bone to create a Skeleton in your hand.

name: Double Death
text: Rulebook: When another creature you own dies, it is returned to life and dies again immediately.

name: Double Strike
text: Rulebook: A card bearing this Sigil will strike the opposing space an extra time when attacking.|speaker=Rule Book}}

name: Energy Conduit (sigil)
text: Rulebook: If a card bearing this sigil is part of a completed circuit, your Energy never depletes.

name: Energy Gun
text: Rulebook: Activate: Pay 1 Energy to deal 1 damage to the creature across from a card bearing this sigil.

name: Enlarge
text: Rulebook: Activate: Pay 2 Bones to increase the Power and Health of a card bearing this sigil by 1.

name: Fecundity
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, a copy of it is created in your hand.

name: Finical Hatchling
text: Rulebook: A card bearing this Sigil hatches when drawn if the numbers 1 to 5 are represented in the Health of creatures in your deck, and in their Power, and if there is a creature of each tribe in your deck.

name: Fledgling
text: Rulebook: A card bearing this sigil will grow into a more powerful form after 1 turn on the board.

name: Frozen Away
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil perishes, the creature inside is released in its place.

name: Gem Animator
text: Rulebook: Mox cards on the owner's side of the board gain 1 Power.

name: Gem Dependant
text: Rulebook: If a card bearing this sigil's owner controls no Mox cards, a card bearing this sigil perishes.

name: Gem Detonator (sigil)
text: Rulebook: When Gem Vessels on the owner's side of the board die, they Detonate (the creature opposing them, as well as adjacent friendly creatures, are dealt 10 damage).

name: Gem Guardian (sigil)
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, all Gem Vessels on the owners' side of the board gain Nano Armor.

name: Gem Spawn Conduit
text: Rulebook: Empty spaces within a circuit completed by a card bearing this sigil spawn Gem Vessels at the end of the owner's turn.

name: Gift Bearer
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil perishes, a random card is created in your hand.

name: Gift When Powered
text: Rulebook: If a card bearing this sigil is within a circuit when it perishes, a random card is created in your hand.

name: Guardian
text: Rulebook: When an opposing creature is placed opposite to an empty space, a card bearing this sigil will move to that empty space.

name: Handy
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, discard your hand then draw a new hand of 4 cards.

name: Healing Conduit
text: Rulebook: Other creatures within a circuit completed by a card bearing this sigil are healed at the end of the owners turn.

name: Hefty
text: Hefty is a Sigil which allows a card to move in the direction inscribed in the sigil at the end of the owner's turn, pushing any cards in the way in the same direction.

name: Hoarder
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, you may search your deck for any card and take it into your hand.

name: Hostage File
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil perishes the file used to create it is really deleted from your Hard Drive.

name: Leader
text: Rulebook: Creatures adjacent to a card bearing this sigil gain 1 Power.

name: Loose Tail
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil would be struck, a Tail is created in its place and a card bearing this sigil moves to the right.

name: Looter
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil deals damage directly, draw a card for each damage dealt.

name: Made Of Stone
text: Rulebook: A card bearing this sigil is immune to the effects of Touch of Death and Stinky.

name: Many Lives
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is sacrificed, it does not perish.

name: Marrow Sucker
text: Rulebook: Activate: Pay 2 Bones to heal a card bearing this sigil. This Sigil is strange due to the fact that an image and a description exist for it, yet it remains unused. This sigil is also interesting because is is one of the 2 cards in Act II that are unused, but have an image. The other is Healing Conduit, which is also used for healing. It seems the healing mechanic was never implemented, and it is unknown whether healing would increase maximum health, or simply heal cards up to their max health.

name: Mental Gemnastics
text: Mental Gemnastics is a Sigil in Act II and the Finale of Inscryption. The Blue Mage and Blue Sporemage naturally bear this sigil. When a card bearing the Mental Gemnastics sigil is played, the player will draw cards equal to the number of Mox Cards on their side of the game board.

name: Mighty Leap
text: Rulebook: A card bearing this sigil will block an opposing creature bearing the Airborne sigil. | speaker = Rule Book

name: Morsel
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this Sigil is sacrificed, ⁣it adds its stat values to the card it was sacrificed for.

name: Mox Sigils
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, a (Green, Orange, or Blue) Gem is provided to the owner.

name: Null Conduit (sigil)
text: Rulebook: A card bearing this sigil may complete a circuit, but provides no effect.

name: Omni Strike
text: Rulebook: A card bearing this sigil will strike each opposing space that is occupied by a creature. It will strike directly if no creatures oppose it.

name: One Half Bones
text: One Half Bones is a variable stats present in Kaycee's Mod of Inscryption which causes a cards Power to equal half the Bones the player carries. When the player has an odd number of bones, the power is rounded down (e.g: 3 bones = 1 power). The Lammergeier is the only card to possess this trait.

name: Overclocked
text: Rulebook: A card bearing this sigil has increased power. But, if a card bearing this sigil perishes, it is permanently removed from your deck.

name: Power Dice
text: Rulebook: Activate: Pay 1 Energy to set the power of a card bearing this sigil randomly between 1 and 6.

name: Rabbit Hole
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, a Rabbit is created in your hand.

name: Rampager
text: Rulebook: At the end of the owner's turn, a card bearing this sigil will move in the direction inscribed on the sigil. Creatures in the way will be thrown back behind it.

name: Repulsive
text: Rulebook: If a creature would attack a card bearing this sigil, it does not.

name: Ruby Heart
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil perishes, a Ruby Mox is created in its place.

name: Scavenger
text: Rulebook: While a card bearing this sigil is alive on the board, opposing creatures also grant Bones upon death.

name: Sentry
text: Rulebook: When a creature moves into the space opposing a card bearing this sigil, they are dealt 1 damage.

name: Sharp Quills
text: Sharp Quills is a Sigil which makes the bearer deal 1 point of damage to an attacker of said card.

name: Shield Latch
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil perishes, its owner chooses a creature to gain the Nano Armor sigil.

name: Skeleton Crew
text: Rulebook: At the end of the owner's turn, a card bearing this sigil will move in the direction inscribed in the sigil and drop a Skeleton in its old space.

name: Sniper
text: Rulebook: You may choose which opposing space a card bearing this sigil strikes.

name: Spawn Conduit
text: Rulebook: Empty spaces within a circuit completed by a card bearing this sigil spawn L33pB0ts at the end of the owner's turn.

name: Spilled Blood
text: Rulebook: The value represented with this sigil will be equal to the number of sacrifices made during your turn.

name: Sprinter
text: Rulebook: At the end of the owner's turn, a card bearing this sigil will move in the direction inscribed in the sigil.

name: Squirrel Shedder
text: Rulebook: At the end of the owner's turn, a card bearing this sigil will move in the direction inscribed in the sigil and drop a Squirrel in its old space.

name: Steel Trap
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil perishes, the creature opposing it perishes as well. A Pelt is created in your hand.

name: Stimulate
text: Rulebook: Activate: Pay 3 Energy to increase the Power and Health of a card bearing this sigil by 1.

name: Stinky
text: Rulebook: The creature opposing a card bearing this sigil loses 1 Power.

name: Swapper
text: Rulebook: After a card bearing this sigil is dealt damage, swap its Power and Health.

name: Tidal Lock
text: Rulebook: At the beginning of its owner's turn, a card bearing this sigil will pull small creatures, like Squirrels, into its orbit.

name: Touch of Death
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil damages another creature, that creature perishes.

name: Transformer
text: Rulebook: At the beginning of your turn a card bearing this sigil will transform to, or from, Beast mode.

name: Trifurcated Strike
text: Rulebook: A card bearing this sigil will strike each opposing space to the left and right of the spaces across from it as well as the space in front of it.

name: Trifurcated When Powered
text: Rulebook: If a card bearing this sigil is within a circuit, it will strike each opposing space to the left, right and center of it.

name: Trinket Bearer
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, you will receive a random item as long as you have less than 3 items.

name: True Scholar
text: Rulebook: Activate: If you have a Blue gem, sacrifice a card bearing this sigil to draw 3 cards.

name: Unkillable
text: Unkillable is a sigil that causes a card to return to the owner's hand after death.

name: Vessel Printer
text: Rulebook: Once a card bearing this sigil is struck, draw a card from your Empty Vessel pile.

name: Waterborne
text: Waterborne is a sigil that allows the creature to be submerged for the enemy's turn, causing the opposing creature to skip over it when attacking. The only consistent ways to kill a Waterborne creature are either by doing overkill damage to it before it spawns or by getting it to attack a creature with Sharp Quills.

name: Worthy Sacrifice
text: Rulebook: Cards bearing this sigil count as 3 Blood rather than 1 Blood when sacrificed.

name: Ant
text: This article is about the trait. For the power stat, see Ants. For the creature, see Worker Ant.

name: Uncuttable
text: Uncuttable is a trait. Cards posessing the Uncuttable trait cannot be cut with Scissors, skinned by the Skinning Knife (in Kaycee's Mod) or stolen with the Fish Hook. Even though the Forced Death events in Act I summon many Grizzlys which are intended to be impassable, they are still cuttable.

name: Satisfies Ring Trial
text: Satisfies Ring Trial is a trait possessed by the Ring Worm and Ouroboros. If player has no Ring, Cards bearing this trait will allow to pass Trial of the Ring when drawn.

name: Ants
text: This article is about the variable stat. For the trait which assigns a card as an ant, see Ant. For the creature, see Worker Ant.

name: Card Counter
text: Card Counter is a Variable Stat, representing the Power of certain cards. A card with this variable stat has Power equal to the number of cards in player's hand (even if card is on opponent's side of the board). The Hand Tentacle is the only card with this variable stat.

name: Emerald Power
text: Emerald Power is a variable stat, representing the Power of the Green Mage card. It takes the value of the number of cards giving a Green Mox currently alive on the owner's side of the board. This special behavior is only found in Act II, as the Green Mage can only be found during this act.

name: Bell Ringer
text: The Bell Ringer symbol. Bell Ringer is a variable stat which causes a card's attack stat to increase the closer it is to the combat bell, the value equal to the space number, plus 1 more for each Chime adjacent to it. The Bell Tentacle is the only card to possess this trait.

name: M!rror r0rriM
text: M!rror r0rriM is a Variable Stat, representing the Power of certain cards. A card with this variable stat has Power equal to the Power of a card opposing it. If unopposed, Power equals to 0. The Mirror Tentacle is the only card with this variable stat.

name: Green Mox
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, a Green Gem is provided to the owner. In Act III a Green Mox on the board gives Gemified cards 2 Health.

name: Orange Mox
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, an Orange Gem is provided to the owner. In Act III an Orange Mox on the board gives Gemified cards 1 Power.

name: Blue Mox
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, a Blue Gem is provided to the owner. In Act III a Blue Mox on the board lowers Gemified cards' cost by 1 Energy.

name: Great Mox
text: Rulebook: When a card bearing this sigil is played, a Green, an Orange and a Blue Gem are provided to the owner (it combines the effects of the other three Mox sigils).

name: Kraken Waterborne
text: Rulebook: A card bearing this sigil submerges during its opponent's turn: an opposing creature attacks the space directly, skipping over it. When it re-emerges it transforms into a random Tentacle card (Bell Tentacle, Hand Tentacle, Mirror Tentacle), losing this sigil and its other sigils.

name: Gemified
text: A card chosen at the Gemification event (Act III) is Gemified: it gains no sigil, but while its owner has a Green Gem it has 2 more Health, with an Orange Gem 1 more Power, and with a Blue Gem it costs 1 Energy less.
